title: Admissions CRM for Schools and Colleges
seoTitle: Admissions CRM for Indian Schools and Colleges
seoDescription: An admissions CRM for Indian schools, colleges and training institutes: enquiry capture, counsellor follow-up, WhatsApp, applications and conversion reports.
summary: An admissions CRM captures every enquiry from the website, ads, walk-ins and phone, assigns it to a counsellor, schedules follow-ups and tracks each applicant through to admission and fee payment. Institutes that manage enquiries in registers and spreadsheets usually find many leads never receive a second follow-up.

dataPoints.label: Replaces
dataPoints.value: Enquiry registers, spreadsheets and personal WhatsApp follow-ups

dataPoints.label: Lead sources
dataPoints.value: Website forms, social ads, portals, walk-ins, phone calls

dataPoints.label: Core features
dataPoints.value: Counsellor assignment, follow-up reminders, WhatsApp templates, application tracking, fee link

dataPoints.label: Reports
dataPoints.value: Enquiries by source, counsellor conversion, drop-off by stage

body:
## The admission funnel

| Stage | What the CRM tracks |
| --- | --- |
| Enquiry | Source, course, contact details |
| Counselling | Calls, visits, notes, next follow-up |
| Application | Form status and documents |
| Admission | Fee payment and seat confirmation |

## Where AI helps

A chatbot on the website and WhatsApp can answer common questions about courses, fees and eligibility at any hour and pass qualified enquiries to counsellors. See [AI chatbots for universities and colleges](/blog/ai-chatbots-for-universities-and-colleges-admissions-queries-and-student-support).

Want to see what this would look like for your business? [Book a 30-minute scoping call](/book-consultation).

faqs.q: Can it connect to our ERP?
faqs.a: Yes. Admitted students can move into the student ERP without re-entry.

faqs.q: Is it suitable for coaching institutes?
faqs.a: Yes. The same funnel applies to batches and courses.
